title: Locate
description: Easily find languages by their original local names or international codes.
body:
# 🔍 Locate

**Locate** is a lightweight client-side mod that adds a powerful search bar to your Language Selection screen. Finding your preferred language among hundreds of options has never been easier!

> [!WARNING]  
> **TEST BUILD:** This mod is currently in the **testing phase**. You might encounter minor bugs. Please report any issues on the project page.

---

### ✨ Features:
*   **Instant Filtering**: Quickly find any language as you type.
*   **Smart Keywords**: Search using the English name, the native name (e.g., *Deutsch*, *Español*, *Français*), or the specific language code (e.g., *en_us*, *fr_fr*).
*   **Seamless Integration**: Designed to work perfectly with the default Minecraft interface and the Language Reload mod.

---

### ⚠️ Required Dependencies
To ensure the best performance and compatibility, this mod requires a dependency for specific versions:

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> **For Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.21+:**  
> You **MUST** install the **[Language Reload](https://modrinth.com/mod/language-reload)** mod. 
> *Locate* acts as an enhancement for Language Reload to provide advanced search capabilities.

---

### 🛠️ Installation:
1.  Ensure you have **Fabric Loader** installed.
2.  Download **Locate** and its dependency **Language Reload**.
3.  Place the `.jar` files into your `mods` folder.
4.  Launch the game and navigate to **Settings > Language** to see the search bar.

---
